verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents offline evaluation: you run your application on curated datasets to create experiments, score them with code rules or LLM-as-judge evaluators, and use this during development to catch regressions. SDKs in several languages suggest these runs can be scripted. Nothing in the pack shows a CI integration or a way to gate deployments on eval scores. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g. pytest/GitHub Actions), pass/fail thresholds that block a build or deploy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
